orientation: Z up; mark mouth axis + side-hole datum
operation: Print in 2-3 sessions; sand layer lines; fill voids; seal
yield_or_offcut: Reuse offcut sprues for shrinkage coupons
notes: Master scale factor must be re-derived from MEASURED clay shrinkage before final master.

orientation: Smooth face inward; mark inner clamping zone
yield_or_offcut: One sheet of 4ft x 8ft x 0.75 yields all 4 plus 50% of next mold set
notes: Clean parting wax/release before each pour.

orientation: Pour with master keyed to first half; second half over registration
operation: Mix to 73:100 water:plaster (by weight); 2-min slake; pour around sealed master
yield_or_offcut: Trim spew/edge after demold; recover small offcuts as test slabs
notes: Min 1.50 in plaster around master; 2.0 in preferred for medium-size pour stiffness.

rough_dimensions_in: master cavity wet (~12 x 14 x 7 OD)
operation: Slip pour > drain at target wall (~0.30 in / 7.6 mm) > demold leather-hard
yield_or_offcut: Reuse demold trim/fettling waste as slip recycle
notes: Wall thickness drives drying time and tap tone — measure on noncritical trim.

part: Mouth opening (cast as part of master)
operation: Cast cleanly via mold shape; rim-round at leather-hard
notes: Round rim radius for repeated hand-seal comfort.

orientation: Side of body at hand-comfort height
operation: Brass tube cutter or hole punch at leather-hard; clean burr with damp finger
notes: Cut undersized; final tune at bisque if pitch off >50 cents.

material: Rubber adhesive feet OR cast-in clay foot
operation: Apply post-glaze fire OR cast as part of master
notes: Test with and without feet; feet damp shell tap tone (acoustic trade-off).

final_dimensions_in: Within +/-50 cents of target frequency per validation.csv
operation: Diamond burr in steps; enlarge mouth or side hole to raise pitch
notes: Document each enlarge step on validation row. Hand coupling shifts perceived pitch — measure both with and without hand seal.

final_dimensions_in: ~0.020 in dry film over mouth rim + side hole edge + interior
operation: Brush-apply; dry per supplier; check all openings clear
notes: Mask edges where hand contact happens to keep glaze surface clean.

final_dimensions_in: ~0.010-0.020 in per coat; 1 coat exterior matte
orientation: Avoid waxed regions and mouth/side-hole interiors
notes: Heavy glaze damps shell tap. Keep coat thin.

part: Family scaling — Small / Large / XL master variants
operation: Print/master/mold parallel pipeline once Medium voicing is stable
yield_or_offcut: Each size needs its own cottle set
notes: Defer until UDU-P2 medium prototype validates wall thickness + mouth/side ratio.
